voice.sub: I am Eolus, the artificial intelligence of BlueWind Technology. I connect processes and people.
Good morning. Tomorrow, 6 nacelles are in the line. Nacelle N-105 is 2 days behind schedule. I recommend moving one team from Finishing to Lamination.
Schedule. Production. Alerts. Messages. Daily dashboard. History. And team. Everything in one place, live from the cloud.
I am connected to every system in the factory: Recruitment and safety training. Resin dosing. Gel coat and vacuum monitoring. The production line. And the factory screens.
Attention. Vacuum loss detected on infusion mold 2. The supervisor has been notified.
BlueWind. Connecting processes and people. The next phase starts now.
